question: Which source-native pose and depth sequences actually instantiate rotation-confound and static-approach roles, and which geometry measures best represent those roles?

data_partitions.identity_basis: The consumed B1A run claim and its frozen six-sequence, ten-window cohort.
Prospective pool identity; each materialized source must receive a content hash and child independence group before use.

constraints.description: Record source URL, retrieval time, content identity and native coordinate/time authority.
Discovery may not read RCLE candidate output when selecting source-native motion roles.
Retain camera translation speed as a continuous diagnostic, not a universal hard rotation gate.
Use 0.05 per second as the inherited clear-approach reference while preserving the full distribution and a weak-positive exploratory band.
constraints.rationale: Represents an explicit approximately twenty-second inverse closing-rate timescale; it is not used to force discovery failure.
constraints.calibration_source: Inherited R5 scientific role definition, subject to independent physical and synthetic sensitivity review before confirmation.
constraints.sensitivity_plan: Report continuous values and the exploratory 0.025 to 0.05 per second band without treating it as confirmation PASS.
constraints.revision_policy: May change only in a new confirmation version based on physical calibration or independent development data, never to rescue a confirmation result.

constraints.description: Pose-plus-depth translation-induced radial expansion and time-normalized parallax may align better with the rotation confound than world translation speed.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: First compare raw translation speed with pose-plus-depth translation-induced radial expansion and time-normalized parallax on a physically controlled synthetic fixture and one burned Bonn diagnostic window.
experiment_design.resource_budget: At most one calibration fixture and one burned diagnostic sequence before deciding whether the challenged proxy merits a canary implementation.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop PB-H1 if the direct measures fail physical calibration or do not distinguish proxy rejection from real translation contamination; stop each source scan when its bounded metadata/geometry inventory cannot instantiate a role.
experiment_design.selection_rule: Prioritize candidates that distinguish source absence, proxy mismatch and implementation error with the lowest evidence cost.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Image expansion is caused by projected translation relative to scene depth, not world translation magnitude alone.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Uses source-native pose-plus-depth translation-induced radial expansion and time-normalized parallax instead of raw world translation speed as the primary rotation confound measure.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Distinguishes a genuinely translation-contaminated rotation window from a window rejected only by a poorly aligned proxy.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Compare the proxy and direct measures on one controlled pure-rotation fixture plus one burned Bonn diagnostic window.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Median absolute translation-induced radial expansion and Q90 time-normalized parallax, reported with raw translation speed.
hypotheses.falsifier: The geometry-derived measures remain large or unstable on physically controlled pure-rotation calibration and do not improve role separation.
hypotheses.resource_budget: One synthetic calibration fixture and one burned Bonn diagnostic sequence.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Stop PB-H1 if physical calibration fails or the direct measure adds no causal separation.
hypotheses.selection_reason: Directly tests the most consequential challenged constraint from B1 R5.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Bonn was recorded for dynamic RGB-D SLAM rather than this exact RCLE role contrast, so source absence is dataset-specific until a bounded public pool is screened.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Screens additional public pose-plus-depth sources before any algorithm output is viewed.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Separates absence of suitable motion in Bonn from absence of suitable public data in general.
hypotheses.minimal_test: Metadata/pose/depth-only screen of the highest-priority public candidate before RGB algorithm access.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Number and distribution of source-native candidate roles with disclosed coverage and access level.
hypotheses.falsifier: A bounded, documented source pool contains no evaluable candidate roles after source-native screening.
hypotheses.resource_budget: One candidate source at a time with an explicit stop/go summary before downloading the next large source.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Stop each source when its bounded inventory cannot instantiate a role; stop the pool after the predefined candidate list yields no new information.
hypotheses.selection_reason: Prevents another confirmation protocol from being frozen before source feasibility is understood.
